doc.summary: Canonical reader for the FactStore ``policy_facts.json`` document.
doc.description:
The on-disk truth is host-keyed and written by ``skills.lazyown_facts``
``FactStore.save``::

    {
        "<ip>": {
            "services": [{"host": ..., "port": ..., "protocol": ...,
                          "service": ..., "product": ..., "version": ...,
                          "state": ...}],
            "credentials": [{"host": ..., "username": ..., "password": ...,
                             "source_file": ..., "hash_value": ...,
                             "hash_type": ...}],
            "vulnerabilities": [{"host": ..., "vuln_id": ..., "severity": ...,
                                 "title": ..., "url": ...}],
            "shares": [...], "access": [...], "paths": [...],
            "raw_files": [...], "os_hint": "..."
        },
        ...
    }

Historically some consumers assumed a wrapped legacy shape
(``{"hosts": {...}, "credentials": [...]}``). Every reader now goes
through :func:`load_policy_facts` so both shapes resolve to one
host-keyed canonical form; writers remain FactStore only.

name: load_policy_facts
signature: def load_policy_facts(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]

returns.description:
``{ip: host_record}`` with only dict-typed records. Legacy
wrapped documents (``{"hosts": {...}}``) are unwrapped. Returns
an empty dict for missing, unreadable, or non-object documents.

name: canonical_policy_facts
signature: def canonical_policy_facts(data: Any) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]

doc.summary: Project any legacy or canonical facts document to host-keyed form.

returns.description:
Host-keyed mapping containing only dict-valued host records.
Wrapped documents resolve via their ``hosts`` object first.

name: iter_host_records
signature: def iter_host_records(host_keyed: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]

doc.summary: Yield ``(ip, record)`` pairs from canonical host-keyed facts.

yields.description: Tuples of host IP and its record.

name: iter_flat_facts
signature: def iter_flat_facts(host_keyed: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]

doc.summary: Yield one flat record per fact kind found in the host map.
doc.description:
Each record carries ``type`` (``service`` | ``credential`` |
``vulnerability`` | ``share`` | ``access`` | ``path``) and merges
the underlying fact fields. ``observable`` is derived per kind:
service name, ``user:password`` / hash, or ``vuln_id``.

yields.description: Flat fact records suitable for finding-style consumers.
